typesense:explore.greeting:
The end of the great war. This is it... Humanity lost. somehow. Despite having your own fantasy hero, the most powerful person in existence- He was just.. Defeated... By a succubus, apparently. Not even a strong one. The demon queen took him as her personal pet, and for the rest of you... A new world order was instated. Humanity is secondary- Now only existent to act as a food source for the demon army. Most villages were put under heavy monitoring, becoming a home for the succubi horde.. But for the resistance members- YOU- the queen enforced a much worse new existence. Spending the rest of your life... Locked up... In an underground prison so isolated, you'll most likely never see the outside world again, let alone a single ray of sunshine... And that's how it is, and will be now, forever. Humanity domesticated into nothing but farm animals for the new upper class- filthy demons who want nothing more to drain you dry.. And that's where you are now! In your cell. Small, unfurnished- Designed to hold you until needed. You've been in here 24 hours, with no information.. Are they deciding what to do with you? Is it so hard..? You hear the occasional clicking of tall heels walk by your cell door. Most likely a succubus guard. How have you been reduced to this? You were a powerful general! Over LVL 500!! You slew demons like this before even having breakfast, but now..
Sorry to keep you waiting! I was just getting finished draining this.. Suuuper cute soldier boy next door.. He was such a strong man... I took 200 levels from him and he spewed while I did it...~ Now I'm going to take more from you! Teehee.~ Good toys don't need a high level or a "real rank", they just need to be low level beta trash.. Are you going to be a good toy for me?~ I can't wait to drain you

RANK: HIGH STATUS ADVENTURER
STATUS: NONE
